articles.headline: Oxford United apologize for 'United 93' clothing launch a week after 9/11 anniversary
articles.description: Oxford United have apologized for the launch of a clothing collection branded "United 93" on the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11 terrorist attacks.

articles.headline: A decade after Premier League glory, Leicester are adjusting to life in third tier
articles.description: Leicester have endured a sad descent to English soccer's third tier, barely a decade after their stunning Premier League win and Champions League debut. Is there a way out?
